texts.title: Your first week in a new job

paragraphs.text: Your first week in a new job can feel overwhelming. You will meet many people, and it is normal to forget names. Keep a notebook and write down who does what, so that you know who to ask later.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Try not to say yes to every request straight away. New employees often want to impress, but taking on too much can mean doing several tasks badly. It is fine to check with your manager which jobs matter most.
paragraphs.label: B
